title: Digitising Examination Scripts before Sending Them to Cambridge for Marking
what_it_is: Digitising Examination Scripts before Sending Them to Cambridge for Marking

sections.label: Stolen scripts and exam fairness
sections.summary: Cambridge Assessment said scripts were stolen for the first time and will review processes, while SEAB studies electronic marking and a Member asks how MOE's measures are fair to other candidates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Cambridge Assessment has shared that this is the first time examination scripts were stolen and it is taking this unfortunate incident very seriously.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Cambridge Assessment has assured the Ministry of Education (MOE) and the Singapore Examinations and Assessment Board (SEAB) that they will review their processes to ensure the security of examination papers and scripts and safeguard the integrity of our national examinations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Indeed, SEAB is studying the option of scanning and marking answer scripts electronically.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: This would potentially reduce the risks, such as theft or misplacement, associated with transporting hardcopy examination scripts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In relation to the case of the 238 GCE "A" level Chemistry examination papers that went missing or were stolen, rather, may I ask how did the measure taken by MOE, to assess the candidates by giving them an aggregate score or to allow them to re-sit their exams, square against the need to be fair to the other candidates, and make sure that they are not disadvantaged?

sections.label: Statistical models predicting candidate performance
sections.summary: MOE, SEAB and Cambridge Assessment have a number of mathematical and statistical models derived to predict or triangulate a candidate's final performance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Between MOE, SEAB as well as Cambridge Assessments, we have not just a single model but a number of mathematical and statistical models derived to predict, I suppose, or triangulate the final performance of a candidate.

sections.label: Re-sit choice and other candidates
sections.summary: The proxy was felt reasonable, candidates were given the choice to re-sit, and no other candidates were disadvantaged.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It was felt that this was a reasonable proxy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But the choice was then given to the candidates should they wish to re-sit the paper.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In the process, none of the other candidates, who had their scripts properly marked and went through the process, were in any way disadvantaged.
